'''Koval Transport''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] company based on [[Koval Station]], which orbited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. They provided transportation between the orbiting [[Space station/Legends|station]], which enforced a partial quarantine on the planet to prevent the spread of [[Droch/Legends|drochs]], and points on the surface.<ref name="FOTJC" />
